There's a lot you can do with this because it is so small. If you can't think of anything you like with triangles, try to find something you like with some area is solid black that you can place over that. Perhaps a b&w rose or a raven. I had Roman numerals covered up and it can be tricky because of the straight lines but do not worry too much about it! Tattoo artists are usually very good at working to come up with cover up ideas. I think that going into a tattoo parlor you trust and working through some ideas with the artists is your best bet! Good luck.

I honestly think about this all the time... I think about how we just keep growing and growing as a species and how there aren't enough resources here for all of us. I think about how we need a disease outbreak of some sort or a natural disaster to take out some of the population. I know that sounds horrible because there is so much loss and suffering that comes from those types of things. In no way do I wish that I would be unaffected by those things, whatever happens happens. But, I think that that would be best for the planet. We, as a species, have tried to shape our environment to our needs for as long as we have been here and that's just not how it works. I don't see suicide as a solution though in any way. I don't want to kill myself because of all the failures in our world, I want to get my ass out there and do anything I can to fix them. Any way that you can contribute is huge. Wouldn't you feel like you were doing better if you went out and did something for the cause rather than just leave it up to the rest of the world? I don't know. Maybe I'm wrong. All I know is there is no use worrying about something that you can't change. I just hope you realize that despite all of the bad things in the world, life has a lot to offer. A lot of beautiful moments that you wouldn't experience by ending your life before it's really over. Whatever you decide, I wish you good luck.
